text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from North York Community Council to introduce overnight on-street permit parking on Elm Road, between Douglas Avenue and Bedford Park Avenue, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week. Area residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Elm Road, between Douglas Avenue and Bedford Park Avenue to accommodate their long term parking needs without being subject to tagging by Parking Enforcement Officers.

North York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment of Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate both sides of Elm Road, between Douglas Avenue and Bedford Park Avenue, on a street name basis, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week.
